title: Odell Beckham Jr. shows he can contribute in Giants' preseason opener with roster crunch looming

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Odell Beckham Jr. shows he can contribute in Giants' preseason opener with roster crunch looming
sources.description: Odell Beckham Jr. had the MetLife crowd on its feet when he checked in on Saturday for the Giants' preseason opener and showed he can contribute, but needs to prove he deserves a roster spot.
